title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Soliloquy of Distant Island Peaks
description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Time to head to Guyun Stone Forest this time.

mainQuestExcel.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Soliloquy of Distant Island Peaks
mainQuestExcel.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Time to head to Guyun Stone Forest this time.

dialogs.text: Take this child to see the outside world. That which I cannot do myself, I leave to you.
Mm! Training is fun!
As long as you're having fun.
Yellow Fur very strong. Kapow — big and round thing gone.
That's because I train regularly, you know?
Mm! Kichiboushi, become strong like Yellow Fur!
Train, train, and train. Strong-strong!
What do you plan to do once you become stronger, Kichiboushi?
Get back at Gyoubu Koban, mmhaha!
Then make Ioroi not stone.
Good luck. As for your training route, just leave it to us.
Mm!
Let's have fun then. See you later.
Yey!
Different from snow mountain. Not cold. No snow.
This is Guyun Stone Forest! Legend has it that this is where Rex Lapis defeated that, uh, many-headed water snake thingamabob — what was its name again?
The Overlord of the Vortex?
Right, that's the one! Osial, the Overlord of the Vortex! This is where it was defeated by Rex Lapis' stone spears and sealed.
Ooh!
Cool, eh? But we fought with it too, y'know? Atop Ningguang's Jade Chamber...
Golden Crystalfly!
Wait, so that was what you were gushing over? C'mon, Paimon's telling a story over here!
Well, it does look different from the ones in Inazuma...
He's probably never seen a Crystalfly that wasn't purple...
#Well... Guess that's true. Alright, alright. Why don't you catch one for him, {NICKNAME}?
And you're not gonna do it?
Well, you've got more experience at this.
It can be done, but we can only capture its Crystal Core.
Yey! Nice!
But you're the one who can fly.
True, but you've got more experience at catching 'em!
Alright.
Osial?
Kapow~ Crystalfly~ Golden Crystalfly!
Not gold.
Huh? The Crystal Core really isn't golden!
Well, you both say that, but...
Come to think of it, Paimon's never really noticed this even though you've caught lots of Crystalflies in the past...
...Is this what they call "disillusionment"? You know, the thing that happens when you get older?
Looks like you're in need of some training yourself, Paimon.
White Fur, can do it.
Don't you "you can do it" Paimon! You're the one who's training, Kichiboushi.
Still, it is kinda disappointing. Why are the Crystal Cores of Geo Crystalflies not gold?
Right. Gold Crystalfly, why not gold?
Crystalflies might just be that kind of organism.
Oh well, then. In any case, let's proceed as we planned. Time to take Kichiboushi to see The Alcor!
I honestly don't know the answer to that question.
There's not much I can do about it.

flow.stepDescription: Go to a place from which you can see The Alcor

dialogs.text: See The Alcor!
Amazing! So much water!
And so big! So big, on the water!
So big, must be heavy. Why not sinking?
That's because The Alcor is a ship.
But, mud boat sink. Ioroi tell story. Story of rabbit, bake-danuki, and the mud boat.
Um, well, The Alcor isn't made of mud. That's why it won't sink.
Why will not-mud ship not sink?
Huh, you're becoming more fluent, Kichiboushi. But at the same time, how are we supposed to answer this question...
#Right! Hehe, {NICKNAME}, why do ships float on the water's surface?
Ships are made of wood. All hail the power of Dendro!
Eh? Can Dendro really do that?
Um... Then why don't hilichurls with wooden shields float?
Mmmph. Didn't get it.
Don't worry, Kichiboushi. Someday, when you're older, you'll be as smart as Paimon! Then you'll understand all these things: why ships float, why it snows in Dragonspine... You'll know it all!
I'm not sure you know either, Paimon.
Hey, come on!
Yup! Whatever the case, we can see The Alcor from here. Let's take a photo of Kichiboushi!
Photo! Drawing!
Yup, that's right! Alright, stand still for a moment now!
It's fine if you don't get it yet.
You can get by without understanding some things.
Ships can float as long as their buoyancy exceeds the pull of gravity.
Ooh, is that how it is? Paimon gets it.
Next, let's bring Kichiboushi onboard The Alcor!
Not good. If boat sinks...
Relax, this boat won't sink.
This ship took us all the way to Inazuma.
Exactly! And that's how we came to meet you and Ioroi. So don't worry, it'll be fine!
Mm! Understood.
Captain Beidou is a real steady hand, and so are the rest of her crew. Basically, this ship is the safest place on the high seas!
Mm! Yey!
See! The view's great, isn't it?
Mm! Very good!
Many mountains over there. What place is that?
Hmm? Well...
That's Inazuma.
That's right. That should be Mt. Yougou over there — and beneath it? That's where Chinju Forest is.
So far. Ioroi, across the sea.
That's right. But we'll be with you all the way!
Mm!
Well then, where to next...
Is there somewhere familiar where we can find some good food?
Of course it's about food with you, Paimon.
Good food, good idea!
#Aw! See, {NICKNAME}? Kichiboushi knows what's up. Eating all the good food in the world is good training too, you know?
Kichiboushi will surpass you pretty quick if you don't wise up!
Right? Climbing the mast sure was tiring.
White Fur climb? But White Fur can fly.
Eh, details!
Whatever the case, we'll stop here today. Paimon's gotta have a good think about where we'll go next.
Mm!
Guess it's just as well that I'm feeling a little peckish.
That's where you're from.
